title: Change the caller’s value
prompt: Double a nonnegative value through an int reference. Input is 0–1000, so the result fits. The function returns void; the driver prints the changed caller value.

tests.label: Upper input
tests.hint: The input bound keeps the result safe.

tests.label: Same caller object
tests.hint: A reference names the caller’s object.

hints: int& means the function receives another name for the same int.
Changing a copy does not change the caller.
explanation: Pass by reference shares the object. A void function can still have an effect by changing the object it borrowed.
